title: Run Church boolean logic
description: This program defines Church boolean selectors and composes them into NOT, AND, OR, and if-then-else.

steps.description: TRUE selects its first argument and FALSE selects its second. NOT, AND, and OR compose those selections.
church_to_bool supplies Python True and False. show_bool supplies string labels so a Church boolean chooses its own displayed name.
These prints decode TRUE and FALSE, then display the listed NOT, AND, and OR applications.
The final examples use a Church boolean directly as an if-then-else selector between yes and no.
